listicles.title: 100 Encouraging Messages - Friends
listicles.description: Explore 100 uplifting, encouraging messages to hype up your best friend, coworker, or partner. Copy your favorite text or send an anonymous digital card.

sections.heading: When They're Doubting Themselves
messages: You're so much more capable than that voice in your head is giving you credit for.
I've watched you figure out harder things than this. You've got it.
Feeling unsure doesn't mean you're not ready. It usually means you care.
If you could see yourself the way I see you, you'd never doubt this for a second.
You don't have to feel confident to be capable. You already are.
Imposter syndrome only shows up for people who are actually doing something. Keep going.
Remember the last time you thought you couldn't do something? You did it anyway.
Your best is enough. It always has been.
You earned your spot. Nobody handed it to you.
Be as patient with yourself as you are with everyone else.

sections.heading: Before a Big Day
messages: Big day tomorrow! You've prepared for this. Now go let it show.
Deep breath. You know more than you think you do. Good luck today!
Walk in there like you already belong, because you do.
Whatever happens today, I'm proud of you for showing up.
Rooting for you so loudly right now. Go get it.
Nerves just mean it matters. You've got this.
Text me the second you're done. I want to hear everything.
You don't need to be perfect today, just yourself. That's always been plenty.
Sending you calm hands, a clear head, and all the luck in the world.
Today is just another day you get to be great at something.

sections.heading: When They're Going Through a Hard Stretch
messages: This season is hard, but it isn't forever. I'm with you through all of it.
You're carrying so much right now. It's okay to put some of it down.
Not every day has to be a good day. Getting through it counts.
I'm really proud of how you're handling all of this, even when it doesn't feel like it.
Slow progress is still progress. Keep going at your own pace.
You don't have to have it all figured out. You just have to get through today.
When you're tired, rest. Don't quit. There's a difference.
I know it's heavy right now. Lean on me as much as you need to.
A hard chapter doesn't mean it's a bad story. Yours is going somewhere good.
You've survived every hard day so far. That's a pretty great track record.

sections.heading: Short and Sweet
messages: You've got this.
Proud of you. Always.
Keep going. You're closer than you think.
You're doing amazing. Seriously.
Still your biggest fan.
One step at a time. You're doing it.
Believe in yourself the way I believe in you.
Don't forget how far you've come.
You make hard things look easy.
Cheering for you from right here.

sections.heading: When They're Working Toward a Goal
messages: Every small step you take is adding up, even when you can't see it yet.
Consistency beats perfection, and you've been so consistent.
The fact that you're still trying says everything about who you are.
Future you is going to be so grateful you didn't give up today.
You don't need to go fast. You just need to keep going.
I love watching you work toward something you care about.
Your hard work is going to pay off. I really believe that.
Remember why you started. That reason is still a good one.
You're building something real. Be proud of every brick.
It's okay if it's taking longer than you hoped. You're still on your way.

sections.heading: After a Setback or Bad News
messages: One setback doesn't erase everything you've done. Not even close.
I'm so sorry it didn't go the way you wanted. It doesn't change how amazing you are.
Their no isn't the final word on what you're worth.
Take a day to be disappointed. Then let's figure out what's next together.
Failing at something means you were brave enough to try it.
This isn't the end of the road. It's a detour.
It's okay to be upset. You worked really hard for this.
The right door is still out there. This one just wasn't it.
You're allowed to grieve the plan and still build a new one.
I'd bet on you again tomorrow, and the day after that.

sections.heading: Reminding Them Who They Are
messages: You're one of the kindest people I know, and the world needs more of that.
The way you show up for people is rare. I hope you know that.
You make every room you walk into a little bit better.
I'm so lucky to have a friend like you.
You're stronger than you give yourself credit for, and softer in all the right ways.
Your laugh fixes about 80% of my bad days.
You're allowed to take up space. You deserve to be here.
Being your friend is one of the best things that's ever happened to me.
You're doing better than you think you are.
Never forget: you're the main character. Act like it today.

sections.heading: Funny and Light
messages: Reminder that you're a genius and everyone else is just catching up.
If anyone gives you trouble today, just know I'll fight them. Emotionally.
You're doing great, and your snack choices are also excellent.
Legally I have to tell you that you're awesome. It's in the friendship contract.
Drink some water, you beautiful, overworked houseplant.
On a scale of 1 to amazing, you're somehow at 11 today.
You're the human version of finding money in an old jacket.
Whatever you're stressing about, you'll handle it. You once built flat-pack furniture without crying. Mostly.
Today's forecast: 100% chance of you absolutely crushing it.
You're basically a superhero, just with more coffee.

sections.heading: For a New Chapter
messages: New city, new job, new chapter. You're going to make this place feel like home.
Congrats on taking the leap! Scary and brave usually look exactly like this.
Starting over takes more courage than people realize. I'm so proud of you.
You don't need to have it all figured out on day one. Give yourself time.
They're lucky to have you. I hope they realize it quickly.
Every expert was once exactly where you are now: new.
Change is hard, but you've never been one to shrink from something hard.
Here's to the version of you this new chapter is going to bring out.
Go make some new memories. Just save me the best stories.
Nervous and excited is the perfect combination. Enjoy every bit of it.

sections.heading: From Far Away
messages: The distance doesn't change anything. I'm still right here for you.
Wish I could give you a real hug. Consider this one on account.
Miles away, and still your loudest cheerleader.
Just because I'm not there doesn't mean I'm not in your corner.
Call me anytime, day or night. The time zone is my problem, not yours.
Sending you all my good energy from here to wherever you are.
I think about you more than you know, and I'm always rooting for you.
Can't wait to celebrate this with you in person.
You're never as alone as it feels. I'm one text away.
However far apart we are, you're still one of my favorite people.

listicles.title: 50 Texts for a Hard Day - Support
listicles.header_title: 50 Texts to Send Someone Having a Hard Day
listicles.description: Discover 50 comforting texts to send someone having a hard day. Thoughtful, empathetic words to let them know they are loved, seen, and not alone today.

sections.heading: When You Don't Know What to Say
messages: I don't know exactly what to say, but I'm here and I care about you.
I'm so sorry today has been so hard. You don't deserve this.
That sounds really rough. Thank you for telling me.
I wish I could fix it. Since I can't, I'm going to stay right here with you.
There's no perfect thing to say, so I'll just say this: I love you.
I'm not going anywhere. Today, tomorrow, whenever.
I'm so sorry. That's genuinely awful.
I hate that you're going through this. I'm in your corner.
You don't have to explain anything. I just wanted you to know I'm thinking of you.
I can't make it better, but I can make sure you're not alone in it.

sections.heading: No Reply Needed
messages: No need to reply. Just sending you a little love today.
Thinking of you. Don't feel like you have to answer this.
Just a reminder that you're loved. No response required.
Sending a hug through the phone. Reply whenever, or never. Both are fine.
I know today is hard. Here if you need me, quiet if you don't.
You don't owe anyone energy today, including me. Just know I care.
Put your phone down after this if you need to. I'll still be here.
Silence is totally okay. I just wanted you to feel a little less alone.
Leaving this here for whenever you see it: you matter to me.
Zero pressure to text back. Just thinking of you.

sections.heading: Offers of Real, Practical Help
messages: Can I bring you dinner tonight? You don't even have to see me. I'll leave it at the door.
Want me to come over and just sit with you? We don't have to talk.
Is there one thing I can take off your plate today?
I'm going to the store later. Tell me what you need and it's yours.
Want to go for a quick walk later? Fresh air, no deep talks unless you want them.
I can call you, text you, or give you space. Just tell me which one helps.
Do you want advice, a distraction, or just someone to listen? I can do all three.
I'm free tonight if you want to vent, watch something silly, or both.
Let me handle an errand or two this week so you can breathe.
If you need someone to drive, pick something up, or just show up, I'm your person.

sections.heading: Gentle Perspective
messages: This day will end, and tomorrow gets to be a new start.
You only have to get through the next hour. Then the one after that.
It's okay to have a bad day. It doesn't make it a bad life.
Be gentle with yourself tonight. You've been through a lot.
Feelings this big don't last forever, even when it feels like they will.
You've gotten through hard days before. This one won't win either.
Nothing needs to be solved tonight. Rest is allowed.
It's okay to cancel plans, skip the chores, and just take care of you.
Tomorrow doesn't have to be perfect. It just has to be a little easier.
Doing the bare minimum today is still doing something.

sections.heading: Just Love
messages: Sending you the biggest hug right now.
I love you, and I'm proud of you for getting through today.
You're one of my favorite people, even on your worst days. Especially then.
The world is better with you in it. Today included.
I'm so grateful for you. That doesn't change on hard days.
Whatever today looked like, you're still so loved.
Wrapping you in a giant imaginary blanket of good vibes.
You deserve so much softness right now.
I'm always on your team. No matter what.
I see how hard you're trying, and it matters.

listicles.title: 75 Thinking of You Messages - Smile
listicles.description: Browse 75 short, sweet thinking of you messages to make someone smile. Copy any thoughtful text or turn it into an interactive 3D card in seconds.

sections.heading: Simple Check-Ins
messages: Hey, you crossed my mind today. How are you really doing?
Just checking in. Hope your week is being kind to you.
Thinking of you and hoping today's a good one.
No reason for this text except that I like you.
How's your heart doing lately?
Just wanted to say hi and remind you that you're awesome.
It's been a minute! Tell me one good thing that happened this week.
Checking in on my favorite person. How are things?
Hope you're taking care of yourself. Drink some water for me.
Random thought: I'm really glad you're in my life.
Hi! Just thinking about you and smiling.
How did that thing you were nervous about go? I've been wondering.
Sending good vibes your way for no particular reason.
Hope you're having the kind of day that makes you feel like yourself.
Just popping in to say I miss your face.

sections.heading: Something Reminded Me of You
messages: Just heard our song in the grocery store and had to text you.
Saw a dog that looked like it would be your best friend. Thought of you immediately.
Walked past that café we love and it made me smile.
Something funny happened today and you're the only one who'd get it.
Found an old photo of us and now I'm in a great mood.
Just watched something you'd love. Adding it to our list.
Every time I see a sunset like this one, I think of you.
A stranger laughed exactly like you today. It was a lot.
Just ate something so good I immediately thought, you need to try this.
Heard someone say your favorite phrase and laughed out loud in public.
Saw the perfect gift for you and had to stop myself from buying it. I might still.
This meme is so you it hurts.
Drove past our old spot today. Still the best memories.
The weather today feels like one of our road trip days.
Read something that reminded me of the talk we had last month. Still thinking about it.

sections.heading: Missing You
messages: Miss you more than I can fit in a text.
Is it weird that I miss you after a week? Because I do.
Counting down until we're in the same place again.
Life's just a little quieter without you around.
Wish you were here for this. It'd be ten times more fun.
Can we plan a catch-up soon? I miss our long talks.
Distance is annoying. You are not.
Sending a hug across however many miles are between us right now.
I keep saving up stories to tell you. The list is getting long.
Just wanted you to know you're missed today.
Every time something good happens, you're the first person I want to tell.
Our next hangout is officially overdue.
Missing you and all our ridiculous inside jokes.
Can't wait to hug you in person again.
Home doesn't feel quite the same without you nearby.

sections.heading: Appreciation
messages: I don't say it enough, but I'm really grateful for you.
Thank you for always being someone I can count on.
You make life feel lighter. Just wanted you to know.
The world got luckier the day you showed up in it. So did I.
You've been such a good friend to me, and I notice all of it.
Thank you for the way you listen. It means more than you know.
I'm proud to know you.
You have a way of making people feel seen. Me included.
Being around you always makes me a better version of myself.
Just a little thank-you for being exactly who you are.
I appreciate you more than my texts probably show.
You're one of the good ones. Truly.
Thanks for always cheering me on. My turn to cheer for you.
Our friendship is one of my favorite things about my life.
I hope someone tells you how wonderful you are today. Starting with me.

sections.heading: Playful and Fun
messages: This is your daily reminder that you're my favorite. Don't tell the others.
Official announcement: I'm thinking about you. That is all.
If you were a vegetable, you'd be a cute-cumber. Sorry. Not sorry.
Just ran a quick scan: you are still 100% awesome.
Warning: this text contains dangerously high levels of appreciation.
I'd share my fries with you. That's how much you mean to me.
Thinking of you. Also thinking of snacks. Mostly you, though.
You've been nominated for Best Human. The results are in: you won.
Beep boop. Friendship check-in bot here. Status: missing you.
Roses are red, my phone's in my hand, just wanted to say that you're kind of grand.
If you need me, I'll be over here being grateful you exist.
I was going to text something deep, but instead: hi, you're great.
Plot twist: someone's thinking about you right now. It's me.
Sending you one (1) virtual hug. No refunds.
Just a random text to say our friendship is elite.
